summary: Apple's MDM framework is a server-side enterprise protocol for remotely managing organization-owned Apple devices through Apple School Manager and Apple Business Manager. BifrOSt has no MDM server, enrollment, declarative management or configuration-profile support, and the Apple deployment services have no Linux counterpart.

features.apple: Automated Device Enrollment, account-driven enrollment (Device enrollment topic)
features.note: Enrollment depends on Apple School Manager or Apple Business Manager accounts

features.feature: MDM protocol: commands, queries and check-in
features.apple: Commands and queries; Check-in (MDM protocol topic)
features.note: Apple push-token MDM channel; no equivalent in BifrOSt

features.apple: Platform Single Sign-on, Managed Device Attestation (Implementing device management topic)
features.note: Apple platform identity services; BifrOSt accounts live in ~/Projects/bifrost-cloud, not in this repo

features.apple: Device assignment, Roster management, App Book and Subscription Management, Apple School Manager and Apple Business APIs (Deployment services topic)

gaps: No MDM or enterprise device-management service exists in BifrOSt; this is out of scope for a Linux desktop unless the product adds fleet management.
